speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis. The negative urinalysis, culture, and renal ultrasound effectively rule out infection and structural abnormalities, pointing toward a chronic bladder condition like interstitial cystitis given your persistent discomfort and frequency.
